_note: Generated by tools/generate_weather_cells_data.py. Every NUMBER is computed at 1 km over 245,077 land cells; only the MAP is downsampled to 5 km.

grid.note: rows are south-to-north; -1 is sea or unpopulated land
grid.bands_note: classes FITTED on households, APPLIED to all GB land -- an uninhabited cell has a temperature and therefore a class

density.note: -2 land outside Great Britain (no household data), -1 sea, 0 GB land with no household, 1+ households per km2. ONE PIXEL IS ONE SQUARE KILOMETRE, which is the resolution the occupancy figures beside it are counted at.
